root_causes.root_cause: RFC-029 D1 low_content_density gate in validate_tree (helpers.py:1342-1356) rejects trees with chars_per_node < 500 when total_nodes >= 200. This new gate was introduced in commit 08b6eea and has no recovery path -- low_content_density is not in the OCR escalation reasons list (client.py:1008), so the tree simply ERRORs. The threshold of 500 chars/node is too aggressive for legal documents with fine-grained article structure: Penal Code (606 nodes, 408.2 chars/node) and marsoom-33-AR (231 nodes, 459.4 chars/node) were previously healthy PASS trees with near-identical metrics. For federal_decree_law_no_33 EN the drop from ~221 to 54.3 chars/node suggests additional over-fragmentation from _repair_docling_tables char reduction (table whitespace stripping reduced total chars while node count held or grew).
root_causes.suggested_fix: Two changes: (1) Add low_content_density to the OCR escalation reasons list in client.py:1008 so the tree gets a recovery attempt instead of immediately ERRORing. (2) Either lower the threshold from 500 to ~200 chars/node (legal articles averaging 300-450 chars/node are legitimate), or raise the node-count floor from 200 to a higher value (e.g., 500) that only catches truly degenerate over-fragmented trees. The docstring at line 1289 says 'total_nodes >= 3' but code uses >= 200 -- fix the docstring too.

root_causes.root_cause: _segment_table_nodes (helpers.py:2307) was implemented in RFC-029 D7 but only wired into the OCR retry path (client.py:1066) and VLM fallback path (client.py:1215). It is NOT called in the primary tree-build path (client.py:981 only calls split_oversized_leaf_nodes). GHV-TKV-Tarif goes through the primary path (no garble/OCR escalation), so _segment_table_nodes never runs and the tariff table stays merged in a single oversized node.
root_causes.code_path: src/pageindex_mcp/client.py::index() primary tree-build path (line 981, missing _segment_table_nodes call)
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add result['structure'] = _segment_table_nodes(result.get('structure', [])) at line 982 (after split_oversized_leaf_nodes, before validate_tree) in the primary tree-build path, matching the pattern already used in the OCR retry path at line 1066.

Need to determine whether _repair_docling_tables whitespace stripping caused massive char reduction, or if the tree builder is creating far more nodes for the same content.
